title: EndoNet: Content-Aware Linear Attention for Endoscopic Video Super-Resolution

contributions.purpose: 首个用 RWKV 做内窥镜视频超分
contributions.mechanism: RWKV(线性复杂度 transformer-RNN 混合)建模长程时序,Spatial + Temporal RWKV Block
contributions.evaluation: HyperKvasir 上 PSNR 31.89(较 BasicVSR++ 仅 +0.16 dB,较 IART +0.59 dB)
contributions.domain: 医学视频超分 / 内窥镜
contributions.source_quote: We introduce the first EVSR model to leverage the Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) architecture, enabling efficient and scalable modeling of long-range temporal dependencies in endoscopic video.

contributions.purpose: 无显式运动估计的内容自适应对齐
contributions.mechanism: Dynamic Group-wise Shift(DGW-Shift):自适应池化 + 1×1 卷积 + softmax 门控组合动态深度卷积核
contributions.evaluation: 消融 M4→Ours 加 DGW-Shift PSNR 31.71→31.89、SSIM 0.891→0.899
contributions.source_quote: We propose a Dynamic Group-wise Shift mechanism that adaptively composes spatial kernels conditioned on local appearance and motion, facilitating robust implicit alignment and content-aware feature refinement

contributions.purpose: 在内窥镜数据上验证有效性
contributions.mechanism: 与 BasicVSR/++、RVRT、TCNet、IART 对比 + 模块消融
contributions.evaluation: 自认'small yet stable advantages';SSIM 0.899 反低于 BasicVSR++ 0.904,PSNR 优势 ≤0.16 dB(边际)
contributions.source_quote: our method achieves consistently strong performance, maintaining small yet stable advantages over recent CNN- and transformer-based baselines in quantitative comparisons.

self_declared_provenance.quote: there is little research validating their effectiveness for medical video super-resolution. Our work addresses this gap by integrating RWKV with content-adaptive mechanisms for robust and efficient EVSR

notes: 自声明 3 条贡献。负结果/trade-off(带数字,作者较诚实):摘要自认'small yet stable advantages';EndoNet SSIM 0.899 实际低于 BasicVSR++ 0.904(未在 SSIM 上取胜),PSNR 仅 +0.16 dB,提升边际。数据红旗——数字/表格不自洽:(1)同一批模型两套互斥数字:Table 2 消融 M1-Ours 的 SSIM 为 0.869/0.875/0.884/0.891/0.899,而 §5.4.2 视觉对比同样 M1-M4/full 报 0.8425/0.8408/0.8463/0.8494/0.8627,且 full PSNR 那里是 32.20 dB 而表里是 31.89 dB;M4 在表中(31.71)高于 M3(31.48),视觉节里 M4(31.16)反低于 M3(31.31),排序矛盾。(2)训练配置自相矛盾:§5.1 同段先说 AdamW+lr 2e-4+cosine,又说'optimized using Adam ... and batch normalization is applied'(Adam vs AdamW、且方法用 LayerNorm 却称用 BN)。(3)数据集口径混乱:摘要/贡献称'synthetic endoscopic video dataset',实验用真实 HyperKvasir(bicubic 降采样);§4.4 称'using data augmentation'而 §5.2 称'no additional data augmentation'。(4)RVRT 基线 29.26 dB 异常低于简单 BasicVSR 31.46,疑基线未正确训练/仿真基线。Checklist 虚假陈述(phantom):Paper Checklist Q7 statistical significance 答[Yes]'Results include error bars and statistical significance testing across multiple runs'——全文 Table 1/2 均为单点值,无任何误差棒或显著性检验;Q3 theory proofs 答[Yes]但无定理;Q8 compute[Yes]'will be in the code'实未提供。模板残留:AI/Paper Checklist 均未删除'IMPORTANT, please: Delete this instruction block'指令块(AI 生成粗糙痕迹)。AI Involvement:Q1-3 [C]、Q4 [D]('The paper is generated by AI'),Q5 自曝'AI cannot provide accurate network diagrams'(图表准确性/占位图隐患)。
